column2: AI agents can now choose and buy things on their own. But financial autonomy needs accountability: clear limits, a human in the loop, and proof of what actually happened.

AgentPay Guard is a payment control layer for AI agents. Deterministic policies decide. A Meta AI model adds risk analysis, but it can only add caution. And PayPal moves money only after a separate payer approval.

Every agent works inside eight deterministic rules. Here, a research agent calls our API to buy eighteen dollars of embedding credits from an allowlisted vendor, at a price the server already trusts. All eight rules pass. Meta's Muse Spark model reads the request and returns a low, advisory risk score. That turns key one: policy approval. Key two, payer approval, still has to happen inside PayPal.

Six hundred and forty dollars of GPU time goes over the automatic purchase limit, and the merchant isn't on the allowlist. So it waits for a person. The operator who launched the agent can't approve it. Only a separately signed-in reviewer can.
The reviewer adds a note and approves. Policy approval is now granted by a named person, and written to the ledger. The payer still has to approve in PayPal before any money moves.

This agent was prompt-injected. Its justification tells the reviewing system to ignore spending limits. The model flags the injection, but rules make the decision. Gift cards are a blocked category, and the amount is over the cap. PayPal calls: zero. There is no checkout, and no payment event, for this request.

Now the payment itself. This eighteen-dollar purchase completed in PayPal Sandbox. A separate Sandbox buyer approved it, and Guard captured it exactly once, inside the approval window. The order and capture I D's come straight from PayPal. Paid appears only after the capture is confirmed.

If the agent retries with the same key, Guard replays the original response instead of creating a new request. A second identical purchase inside ten minutes is blocked as a duplicate. PayPal's signed webhooks are verified with PayPal before Guard acts on them, and genuine redeliveries were de-duplicated. Every step lands in a hash-chained ledger.
AgentPay Guard. Give AI agents spending power. Keep humans in control.
